posts.text:
Over 180,000 Minnesotans — like Gwen Elliot — live in manufactured home communities. When her park was bought by a private equity firm, she needed protections that didn’t exist.

As Governor, I’ll work to stop excessive fees and guarantee residents an opportunity to buy the land beneath their home.

Minnesota has a shortage of about 100,000 homes. Congress passed bipartisan legislation that cuts red tape, lowers costs, and makes it easier to build more houses. That's what families in Minnesota and across the country need.

It's time the president signed it.
